Rachel was outstanding for taking care of them. She spoiled my dogs with so much love and patient. She sent me videos every day. I am so thankful. Thank you Rachel!!  🐾 …

We couldn't be happier with the care our cat sitter provided while we were away for four days! She took amazing care of our three cats and treated them as if they were her own. She sent us daily updates, photos, and videos, which gave us so much peace of mind while we were gone.

She was incredibly honest, trustworthy, and friendly. She even went above and beyond by bringing in a package that was delivered while we were away. It's clear she genuinely cares about both the pets and their owners.

We would absolutely hire her again and will definitely be keeping her number saved for future trips. If we could give more than 5 stars, we would! Thank you so much for taking such wonderful care of our babies we truly appreciate everything you did! 😇🙏
